brief: {"brief":["Names/positioning: ClinicClear—decision-grade triage; SafeSip—fast intake screening; RuralReveal—maintenance-light, locally repairable.","Approach: colorimetric strip kits prioritize simplicity and low training for rural clinics.","Approach: portable incubation/membrane kits trade cost and logistics for higher specificity.","Approach: participatory community testing pairs kits with records and behavior-change follow-up.","Limitation: heat-sensitive reagents and turbidity interference are commonly reported in field evaluations.","Limitation: power, reagent resupply, and maintenance burdens often drive discontinuation in rural deployments, commonly reported.","Strongest criticism: mainstream “lab-grade accuracy” positioning overpromises; clinics need actionable triage and supply resilience, not precision they cannot maintain. Analogy: malaria RDTs accept lower lab precision to enable decentralized, protocol-driven decisions."]}
